prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production macOS app icon for Skill Atlas, a skill-growth constellation app.
Primary request: a WHITE app icon with unmistakable STARS forming a small constellation.
Input image: the supplied reference is for the soft pearlescent pastel COLOR PALETTE only.
Subject: one large, clearly recognizable four-point NORTH STAR, with deeply concave sides and long tapered tips, plus two smaller four-point stars. Arrange these three actual star shapes as an elegant ascending constellation, from a small lower-left star through the large central star to a small upper-right star. Connect them with one delicate but visible neutral gray path. Stars, not circles. The large star is the main silhouette and must be obvious at 32px.
Composition: one centered rounded-square WHITE tile, generous rounded corners, balanced margins. The whole constellation occupies about 65 percent of the tile. Main star occupies about 42 percent of tile width; the small stars about 12 to 17 percent each. Keep the design sparse and distinctive.
Color and material: white porcelain tile, luminous satin-pearl star surfaces with soft cloudy blush pink, lavender, mint, pale peach and ice cyan. White highlights and gentle cool-gray edge shading make the pastel stars readable on white. Subtle shallow relief, restrained soft shadows. A very fine continuous cool-gray outer rim defines the tile's mathematically smooth rounded-square silhouette.
Output: one square app icon, straight-on, high craft, no presentation sheet. Canvas outside the white rounded-square tile is genuinely transparent with a clean smooth alpha boundary.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no watermark, no eyes, no ghost, no circular ring nodes, no triangle network symbol, no dark background, no neon, no glitter particles, no galaxy scene. A clean white tile containing a legible constellation of actual star shapes.
